venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH came in -13.9% vs target on Sunday ($1,854 net vs $2,153).** Food $291. Comps $23.70 (1.27%). 58 guests / $31.97 GCA. **A mostly good night with one big interruption** - the Neuhoff building fire alarm went off around 5:30pm and everyone had to evacuate until 7pm, costing some sales (most guests had already closed out). The team recovered well, with members, regulars and new guests visiting and outstanding food sales. Annie trained today and did a great job moving around the space, interacting with guests and executing cocktails. Kitchen: great food sales, smooth service. No incident; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: introducing Annie to the Sunday regulars and the fishmonger crew - a pleasure to see the camaraderie. MOD: KE & Chef JMS. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR beat target +14.9% on Sunday ($10,750.36 net vs $9,352.12).** Segments: DC/AM $1,428.19 + D&C PM $9,322.17. Food $2,240.50. Comps $402.70 (3.75%). 173 guests (Tock). No events. **An epic Sunday** - steady all the way through, with lots of breakfast in the morning, Kodi killing it on the register and espresso bar, and a big cocktail pop at the 2pm marker. PM ran with two servers and outside of a small pop at open it was manageable all night, with the Garden taking the main brunt of service. Garden/6A: a lovely chill Sunday with Cosette. Kitchen held down the fort while Antonio knocked out dish. Break makeup complete; no-shows not charged; no injury/incident. Favorite moment: working alongside Maggie H, who has a great eye for the operation and will be integral to elevating the group. MOD: Maggie H (AM) / Carey (PM). Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **DCEV beat target +4.7% on Sunday ($4,129 net vs $3,944).** Food $537 / Beverage $3,488 / Retail $40. Comps $81.90 (virtually all MOD error). 119 guests / $35 GCA. **Happy Pride!** After a brutally slow first turn, the team weathered blasts of demand from Pride crowds and service veterans alike, with great anticipation from Dante on point. One large party, 7 solos, 119 covers. Top sellers: Native Lion, Rosalie, Daiquiri, Burner Phone; back-catalog heat was Monarchy of Roses (a spicy, fruity, palate-maximalist Paloma). Door: despite beautiful weather and the Pride parade, an incredibly slow start - MM walked ~half a mile pacing in front of the door to lure folks in (worked a couple times), lots of California IDs to chat with. Stayed slow until ~9pm, full by 9:30 with the room nicely energized; Thomas rocked the floor and the bar crushed service. Quiet finish after 11. Glassware: egg coupe, shot glass, wine glass, N&N. Maintenance: A/C condenser dripping terribly. No-shows not charged. MOD: Thomas & Chef Alejandro. Entered by T. (Report typed '6//27' with a date typo; door notes and post time confirm Sunday 6/28.)

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **DCLA beat target +19.1% on Sunday ($5,396 net vs $4,530).** All Marquee ($5,396); Standing Room $0. Food $1,164. Comps $134 (birthdays, investors, DNL). 129 guests / $94.68 check avg. **A jumping Sunday night** - started with 45 covers, and with lots of activities in the Arts District driving foot traffic, a decent amount of early walk-ins filled the room by 8pm and started a growing waitlist. The team burned and turned all night to clear the list (it kept refilling), and by 11pm cleared everyone for a strong last-call presence. Drinks flowed, a few familiar faces stopped by, and it was a busy Sunday to close out the week. Kitchen: nice work. No incident; no-shows charged. MOD: Joe / Chef Josh + Saleh. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC came in -50.2% vs target on Sunday ($1,685.29 net vs $3,385.20).** All Marquee bar ($1,685.29); Garden $0. Food $122. Comps $30.80 (investor $8.80, did-not-like $22). 40 guests (13 res / 27 walk-ins) / $36.64 GCA. No events. **A rainy, hot and humid night, light on the books with not much foot traffic** - but quality guests and genuine connections. Ben rocked the bar top solo and touched a couple tables; Tyler worked the floor and knocked out prep for the week ahead. Guest Sharona, newly moved to DC, came to find out what the location was about and had a blast; investor Steve Hauss was in with a Crown Royal-only friend, whose night was made by surprising him with some procured Crown. Savannah took down the hanging Garden ferns per Jon's suggestion as it heats up. Kitchen: cookies were the win. No injury/incident; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: well still leaking (photo attached); curtains coming off rails. Favorite moment: guest Kelsie at the bartop sharing her NPR Tiny Desk concert experience, then crashing her best friend's first date at table 41. MOD: Marcus. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.narrative: **Municipal beat target +26.3% on Sunday ($7,830 net vs $6,200).** Segments: AM bar $1,536 + PM bar $3,787 + Sun Club $327 + Hot Eye $1,840. Food $2,641. Comps $183. Event $0. 135 bar guests (57 AM / 78 PM). **A quiet morning and a surprisingly steady night** - brunch missed the usual post-church lunch crowd and the team cut aggressively. The evening stayed steady to the end with a fairly skeletal staff handling everything well (Ezra cut around 8pm; Katie and Chandler helped with glassware; Sam pulled a long shift behind the bar). Not a super-regular crowd but locals and old friends stopped by. Sun Club: not a bad Sunday for the heat. Hot Eye: no guests until the usual 9pm bar crawl filled the room, then a steady flow; 11pm brought chaos with extremely intoxicated tourists and a large service-industry group - one business group bought multiple rounds plus shots for the whole bar (45 mind erasers), high energy and volume right to the lights. Maintenance: pest control needed (palmetto bugs arriving). No injury/incident. Favorite moment: making 45 mind erasers for the entire bar. MOD: Sam & Lex (AM) / James & Marcus (PM). Entered by Alexis.
